description: Legal Affairs Department - Notify the Methodology to Identify Low income families for Welfare Benefit Payments
reasoning: This gazette content establishes a new regulatory framework (Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme) under the authority of the Welfare Benefits Act, No. 24 of 2002. It creates detailed criteria, indicators, and calculation methods for identifying low-income families, which constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements. While a minister is named, the primary focus is on creating legal/regulatory provisions rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or being solely about the personnel appointment.
